label: Relaxation and its bound
subgoals: Enlarge the feasible set by dropping or loosening a hard constraint
Use the relaxed optimum as a bound on the true optimum
Plan the repair step that restores feasibility

label: Decomposition and coordination
subgoals: Split the problem along weakly coupled boundaries
Coordinate the pieces with budgets, cuts or dual prices
Measure the quality lost to the split

label: Search, approximation and certificates
subgoals: Classify an engine as search, approximation or exact dynamic programming
Bracket the optimum between a feasible solution and a relaxation bound
Report the gap as the quality certificate
